result:
All gates confirmed green.

**Root cause:** `ttProbe` in `variants/bug06/tt.inc` branched on Z instead of C when deciding whether a transposition-table entry was deep enough to cut on, so it accepted entries *shallower* than the current search depth and rejected equal-depth ones — collapsing every level above 2 back onto the level-2 answer.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug06/tt.inc` — `jr z,ttNoCut` → `jr c,ttNoCut` (one object byte, `0x28`→`0x38` at `chess.bin` offset 11417; verified with `cmp -l`, no code moved)
- `variants/bug06/depth_test.py` — new regression test, wired into `make test`
- `variants/bug06/Makefile` — `SRC` now lists all five included `.inc` files (`tt.inc`, `zobrist.inc`, `perft.inc` were missing, so `make` did not rebuild after editing `tt.inc`); `make test` now runs the new test. Neither change alters `chess.bin`.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root

**Gates**
- Symptom reproduces on pre-fix build: **pass** (levels 2–5 all f8f7/0)
- Symptom gone after fix: **pass** — endgame L2 f8f7/0, L3–L5 d5e4/30; middlegame L2 d5g2/47, L3–L5 d5g2/77; 48K and 128K agree. Exactly the report's Expected table.
- `make` (variant): **pass**, reproducible byte-for-byte
- `make test` (variant): **pass** — golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft self-test, tape save/load, 128K banked TT, new depth test 19/19
- New test catches the bug: **pass** — 12 of 19 red on the pre-fix tape; also fails an `effDepth`-clamped-to-3 mutant on exactly the rows meant to police levels 4–5
- `characterisation/characterise.py` (57 cases): **pass**, 57 ok / 0 failed / 0 errors, exit 0
- Review: **one round, no blocking findings** — gate closed

**Knowingly left open** (all recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`, all non-blocking, none introduced by this fix):
- `ttStore` labels entries with a stale global `ttCurDepth`, so entries carry the depth of the last node probed in the subtree. Direction is safe (never claims more depth than it has); costs ~10–25% speed.
- The null-move branch in `negamax` flips `sideToMove` without updating `hashKey`.
- The `endgame d3` pin sits ~4% from a clock-budget threshold; documented in the test so a future slowdown isn't misread as a table regression.
- `tt.inc`'s header comment describes the wrong TT size and address.
- The characterisation suite passes 57/57 on the *broken* build too — it never covered this bug, so it evidences only that the fix disturbed nothing.

One correction worth flagging: my initial write-up attributed the flat ladder to stale deep cutoffs. On the report's own two positions the actual route is the clock — losing equal-depth TT hits slowed the search enough that iteration 3 never started (measured `aidIter` = 2 at every level pre-fix). Both routes stem from the same inverted flag; `FIX_NOTES.md` now documents both with the measurements.
